summary: Practise urgent sourcing, supplier evaluation and relief delivery controls. Explore the five-day emergency procurement and logistics course.
lede: Emergency procurement and logistics training helps response teams plan urgent purchases and document the movement of relief goods. Designed for procurement officers, logistics coordinators and response leads, it covers assessing market availability and supplier risks, comparing bids with clear approval evidence, and planning delivery handovers. Exercises develop a sourcing plan, evaluation matrix and receipt checklist, with introductory coverage of digital records and coordination workflows.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who source, approve, move or account for relief goods and services during emergency response. It suits foundation-level learners who want a practical process for urgent purchasing, supplier decisions and logistics handovers.
modules: United Nations Humanitarian Response Depot Dispatch
Emergency Procurement File and Decision Brief
prerequisites: Foundation level. Prior procurement or emergency-response experience is useful but not required. No coding or programming is required.
